audit_title: Inventory of recent ProveIt ETH research proposals

scope.recent_commit_metadata: Latest 100 reachable commits at cutoff, including 12 since2026-10-27T00:40:00Z; three arrival commits and one ETH placement commit identified.
scope.subtree: Full untruncated Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research tree and project README; docs/incoming contains only README after placement.
scope.root_tree_limitation: Repository-wide recursive tree was truncated at 42891 entries; no claim of exhaustive full-repository filename search. The complete target project and all recent ETH intake/placement changes were examined.
scope.report_review: Complete natural-language report bodies and incorporated TeX parts, including proofs, limits, conditional assumptions, and test scope.
scope.not_performed: No full OpenAI proof rebuild, no Lean/Rocq build, no execution of upstream proposal tests; supplied test logs are attributed evidence.

common_frontier.comparison_scope: Normalized contraction size s, maximum degree<=ceil(s^(9/10)), initial precision and truncation<=s, with fixed entry-oracle constants. Coefficients multiply s/sqrt(log_2 s). This does not assert pointwise measured runtime ratios or lower bounds.

novelty_boundary: The exact taper, precision reduction, r=256 schedule, streamed coefficient extraction, scalar parity lift, and density-aware reduction are existing proposals.
The local odd-unit Cauchy Smith profile 4j-2s_2(j) is already proved in eth_density_refinement.

A constructive integral all-level orientation-block factorization preserving source/target group locality, full packet dimension and 6M/D mode-multiplicity envelope is not supplied by any reviewed packet.
Constant refinement cannot be described as proving the conditional n/log n or other order-level targets.

proposals.title: A factorial Cauchy expansion for the subexponential 3-SAT algorithm
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: Finite Cauchy separation on each existing column tile with integral source functions.
Weight w_b=1+b+2 v_2(b!)=3b+1-2 s_2(b), compared with geometric b+1.
Leading logarithm of the abstract mode count reduced by factor 1/sqrt(3) for matched precision and tile count.
Explicit matched whole-contraction bounds with the source schedule and deeper cutoff H=ceil(s/log_2 s).
limitations: No change to logarithmic order s/sqrt(log s) or n loglog n/sqrt(log n).
Prime-subring congruence is necessary; binomial polynomials are not integer-valued at arbitrary unramified-extension elements.
Bound comparisons concern enumeration envelopes, not measured SAT runtimes.
review_notes: Read complete report, including finite remainder identity, transfer of both factorials to target, congruence lemma, recursion compatibility, entropy asymptotic, and global cost.
Its generic auxiliary-row kernel has slope 3. The report explicitly leaves actual reciprocal-row structure open.
The proposed full-orientation mode construction must be compared with this basis combined with the strongest prior taper/schedule, not solely with geometric modes.

proposals.title: Quantitative Improvements to the Exact-Counting Contraction Algorithm
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: Exact condition count h=ceil((M(2L-1)+1)/(L(2u-2+2^(1-u))))=(1+o(1))M/u.
Precision p_t=p+6hD_t+hu(a+1)=(6+o(1))MD_t/u.
Normalized geometric-mode coefficient 648.4410666487529 with r=256, rho=3/128, u_d=floor(lambda/(720*12^d)), a_d=2 sum_{j<=d} u_j, H=ceil(s/lambda).
Comparator for published schedule: 18535.7538316684, including leaf coefficient one.
Streamed homogeneous finite differences extract a packet coefficient in poly(s) product_j(beta_j+1)<=poly(s)2^L time and polynomial space, with up to L extra precision bits for factorial division.

Within its schedule family, continuous boundary coefficient C_*(r)=2 pi sqrt(480 log_2 r)/(ln 2 (1-(6/r)^(2/3))^(3/2)); minimizer r approximately 251.00544, infimum approximately 638.5274898 for geometric modes.
limitations: No improved logarithmic order for unrestricted or fixed-density exact SAT.
The numerical coefficient applies to normalized network size s, not directly to n.
Boundary optimum is an infimum approached by strict feasible schedules, not the declared r=256 rational schedule.
review_notes: Read complete report, including packing exponents, inherited precision, active-depth estimates, path cost, parameter optimization, exact modular division, canonical-lift discipline, and appendices.
Its Max-k-SAT approximation sharpening to n/sqrt(log n) follows from the existing fixed-density theorem and is not a new exact-counting rate.
No full solver or proof-assistant validation is supplied.

proposals.title: Sharper precision for subexponential 3SAT
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: Same exact Hermite condition count and asymptotic precision improvement from 24MD/u to at most 6MD/u.
Exact recovery budget P_t=p+B_i+(q_i-1)(a+1-i), B_i=D_i sum_{j=1}^{a-i}j 2^(-j)(q_i-q_{i+j}).
Real full-loss minimax value W/(u/3+2/9-(2/9)4^(-u)); optimizer q_i=eta((u-i)/6+5/18+(2/9)4^(-(u-i))).
Exact compressed mode-sum representation by ordered group-pair exact-weight ranks using O(M/sqrt(u)+r^2) bits per budget array.

conditional_targets.target: poly(n,m)2^{O(n loglog n/log n)} general, poly(n,m)2^{O(n/log n)} fixed density
conditional_targets.missing_theorem: Structured-mode acceleration using only poly(s)exp(O(M/u)) admissible recursive contraction calls, with preserved degree, precision, descriptions, and polynomial space.
conditional_targets.status: Unproved hypothesis; compressed representation alone does not supply acceleration.

limitations: Taper-only changes cannot improve the leading MD/u loss scale within the full-loss model.
Compact mode indices produce high-degree group tensors; invoking contraction again is not justified.
review_notes: Read complete main report and its conditional sections; reviewed exact taper recurrence and finite-grid correction.
The strongest claimed rate is explicitly conditional; it must not be classified as an achieved solver bound.

proposals.title: Improving the Clause-Density Dependence of Exact k-SAT Counting
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: For fixed k, poly_k(n,m)2^{O_k((n/sqrt(log n)) min{log(2+m/n),loglog n})} bit time and polynomial space, uniform in density.
Initial parity checks from powered lazy Margulis-Gabber-Galil graphs and local codes have support depending polynomially on B log(2B), instead of log m.
Sparsity-sensitive incidence encoding uses O_k(n log(S+2)) wires.
At m=Theta(n loglog n), exponent scale improves to n logloglog n/sqrt(log n).
limitations: Unrestricted n-only and fixed-density orders remain unchanged.
Local-code exhaustive search and degree bounds are asymptotic and extremely impractical.
Imports spectral expander theorem and OpenAI contraction/lift theorems.
review_notes: Read complete report, including explicit integer parameters, graph padding and row count, local-code entropy, shortening, greedy elimination, all complexity overheads, and hybrid cutoff.
Small-instance branch m<=d is direct enumeration of occurring variables; the declared-variable count is retained via a free-variable factor.
Overlaps substantially with eth_density_refinement; they are parallel derivations of the same density envelope.

proposals.title: A density-sensitive refinement of the October 2026 exact #k-SAT counting algorithm
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: For fixed k, A and 1<=B<=(log n)^A, exact counting in poly(n,m)2^{O_{k,A}(n log(2+B)/sqrt(log n))} and polynomial space.
Hybrid extension gives the same all-density minimum envelope as sat_density_improvement.

Exact taper and precision improvements; a conservative eta=1/2048 schedule with r=64 reduces matched mode-enumeration coefficient by 16; resulting mode coefficient 1158.422114 plus leaf coefficient 1.
Max-k-SAT additive approximation exponent n/sqrt(log n) by applying the existing fixed-density solver to the linear-size threshold encoding.
Exact Smith invariant valuations e_j=2j+2v_2(j!)=4j-2s_2(j) for K_{ij}=1/(a+2i-2j) when a is a unit.
limitations: No stronger unrestricted or fixed-density logarithmic order.
The Smith spectrum is a local rank obstruction and not a supplied all-level mode implementation.
review_notes: Read complete report, including expander/local-code alternative for m<=D, row bound 3n, greedy 3n rounds, sparse-query oracle, exact precision, parameter retuning, MaxSAT, dimensional barrier and Smith proof.

Critical novelty boundary: slope4 local Smith valuations were already present here. A new contribution must establish an explicit integral factorization fitting every retained valuation level with unchanged group support and mode multiplicity.
Its density theorem can be retained when installing a better contraction kernel.

proposals.title: A Scalar Parity Refinement of the Subexponential SAT Counter
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: Exact scalar parity indicator E_i=(1+(-1)^c_i product_j(1-2m_ij))/2 over integers.
Local coefficient valuation at least max(0,ceil(|S|/k)-1), and global retained incidence-degree cap k(p+a-1), hence k(n+a) at p=n+1.
Removes the auxiliary V axis; scalar coefficients via Boolean Mobius inversion.
Exact group-pair budget and rank encoding of the mode sum; invalid rank codes contribute zero.

conditional_targets.target: Contraction poly(s)2^{O(s sqrt(loglog s)/log s)}; general SAT poly(n,m)2^{O_k(n (loglog n)^(3/2)/log n)}; fixed density poly(n,m)2^{O(n sqrt(loglog n)/log n)}
conditional_targets.missing_theorem: LF: compact factorization of the actual group tensors using O(W) total edges and maximum degree<=W^(9/10), with affordable entries and canonical precision.
Uniform O(n)-wire, bounded-degree compiler for the union-support counting functional.

limitations: Scalar lift improves arithmetic representation and degree-cap constants, not the leading general-input exponent.
Incidence support indexing remains O(n loglog n); parity and ordinary-degree caps do not change the mode enumeration scale.
review_notes: Read complete report, including scalar coefficient proofs and sharpness, exact counter integration, compression, first-stage large-r schedule, inherited-precision extension, retuned preprocessing, conditional consequences, and union-support alternative.
The local scalar proof is independent of the unproved factorization. It may be combined with new modes, but is already known in this repository.

proposals.title: Asymptotic improvement analysis for the October 2026 3 SAT preprint
proposals.status: Natural-language mathematical derivation relative to the unchanged OpenAI manuscript; finite component-check outputs supplied; not formalized and not an end-to-end solver.
proved_or_imported_refinements: No improved unrestricted runtime established.
Restricted mode-enumeration and nonmonotone Hermite-taper barriers; Newton modes improve only linear valuation constant.
Identifies weaker formalized loglog-squared endpoint and sharper manuscript Appendix D.
Decision-side barriers: root parity does not remove internal precision; total degree<n forces even solution count; genuine SAT parity systems can exhibit incidence entropy Theta(n loglog n).
Additional barriers and leads include indispensable dense subformulas, original-variable Boolean quotient, exterior-power kernels, and extension-field norm hashing.

conditional_targets.target: General SAT poly(n,m)2^{O(n sqrt(loglog n/log n))}
conditional_targets.missing_theorem: Degree-preserving compressed deformation and recursively closed low-mode-multiplicity interface with global K=O(n), wire size s=Theta(n loglog n).
Uniform streaming O(n)-wire contraction compression satisfying complete graph, precision, and entry-cost interface.

limitations: Neither proposed interface is proved; fixed-density exponent is not improved.
Barriers concern particular representations/certificates, not lower bounds for SAT or all tensor contraction.
review_notes: Read report and all incorporated TeX parts: TAPER_AND_NEWTON_LEMMAS, research_routes, degree_route and CONDITIONAL_DEGREE_KERNEL; reviewed research_decision/findings.md and independent paper audit.
Finite checks and selected Lean excerpts do not constitute a full preprint verification or proof-assistant build.
